scope: Linux glibc, non-ASan isolated query; fixed 2048-entry sample table, one in 128 requests. Cumulative requested bytes and counts, NOT live memory, RSS, Apple allocator behavior or query resource ownership. No API/model semantics changed by sampler.
notes: Pure SLL has no observed allocation improvement; it is not included in production.
Initial 128-entry table overflowed; only 2048-entry no-overflow sample is used.
BTree old/new whole-process AB/BA had identical allocation counts; no claim that restart-key borrowing fixes RSS.
Request stacks include row/map/spill and enabled duration-timer labels, as well as ANTLR. Sampling is not full live-allocation attribution.
